thread:
Maria K: Heads up — I just got a notice about a transit strike that started rolling through. I won't make my 00:00–08:00 primary shift tonight. Can someone grab primary? I'm currently listed as primary on the rotation.

Ajay P: I can take primary, but need a quick handoff: any live incidents right now? Also, where's the runbook for the model-worker OOM and any recent deploy notes?

SRE-Bot: ALERT: 1766001200 - model-worker-oom - 6 errors/min - affected: inference-ns/worker-pool (https://alerts.redwood.ai/alert/1766001200) :warning:

Liam R: There was a small spike ~1h ago but it trended down. No open incident bridges at the moment. @Ajay P take the pager, make sure you have the Redis cache flush creds. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/model-oom

Ajay P: Got it — linking runbook here: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/model-oom. Quick commands to check workers: ```kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-worker && kubectl -n inference logs <pod> -c worker``` Also note the safe rollback tag is `model-v2-fallback`.

Jonah T: I can be secondary for tonight. @Maria K do you want me to be the backup? If Ajay needs help during the first 2 hours I can join the bridge.

Maria K: Yes please, @Jonah T — appreciate it. Ajay, handing over my local notes: ssh to infra-bastion uses `--jump infra-proxy`, PagerDuty escalation policy is `PD:infra-night-2`, and I've exported my temporary creds to the team vault.

Ajay P: :thumbsup: I'll take primary. Can someone run the oncall swap so PagerDuty reflects this? I don't want alerts going to Maria.

SRE-Bot: Runbook check-in: recent deploys — `model-serving` rolled at 17:30 UTC with hash `a1b2c3`. No rollbacks. Immediate fallback command: `/deploy rollback model-serving model-v2-fallback` (requires deploy perms).

Liam R: I'll run the swap. Doing: `/oncall swap --from maria.k --to ajay.p --shift 2026-03-15T00:00Z-2026-03-15T08:00Z` now. ⏳

Incident Bot: PagerDuty: schedule updated — primary: Ajay P, secondary: Jonah T. PagerDuty incident routing will start at 00:00 UTC.

Ajay P: Received. Quick question — any open customer-impacting tickets I should know about?

Liam R: Customer impact: none currently. One support thread (SR-3245) reporting slightly higher embeddings latency for a single tenant — being monitored but not escalated.

Ajay P: Okay. I'll watch the latency dashboards. If token latency >200ms p50 or >500ms p95 for 10m, I'll open a bridge and start mitigation. Runbook section "Mitigate index pressure" has the checklist.

Jonah T: If Ajay wants, I can pre-warm the fallback model at 23:45 UTC so cutover is faster. That'll add ~2 GPUs but avoids cold-start latency.

Ajay P: Good plan. Please go ahead. Also @Liam R — can you make sure the canary fallback policy is enabled? Last time it was accidentally disabled.

Liam R: Checked: canary fallback toggled ON. Confirmed via console and cluster tag `fallback-enabled:true`.

Maria K: Thanks everyone. Sorry for the last-minute ask — the strike got announced ~30m ago and there's no alternative route. I've updated my calendar and left a short note on the rotation doc.

Ajay P: :wave: No problem. I'll be on call and will join #incidents if something pops. @Jonah T I'll ping when I start the bridge.

Jonah T: :thumbsup: Pre-warm steps kicking off now: `deploy prewarm --model model-v1 --replicas 4`
